item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i phyag bzhes snang gsal sgron me 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod
item.coloph: zhes dbal phur nag po'i bsdus don phyag bzhes snang gsal sgron me 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod 'di ni/ bslab gsum dbang phyug bzod pa rgyal mtshan dang*/ gnas lnga rig pa'i bang mdzod rab 'byams blo gros 'od zer gnyis kyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ bdag 'dra blo dman rnams la phan snyam nas/ bslab gsum dbang phyug rgyal ba'i bka' lung man ngag thams cad khong du tshud par gyur pa'i/ 'dzam gling bon gyi gtsug rgyan 'a zha blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / mnyam med chen po shes rab rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis (kyi) zhabs brdul (rdul) spyi bor len pa'i/ rje btsun rgya gar dbon ming sku mdun bsod nams blo gros dbang gi rgyal po yis/ sman ri'i bla brang du sbyar ba dge'o/ de ltar dbal phur gyi lag len gsal sgron 'di/ phal dang phal gyi thun mong min/ rnam spral gong ma rnams kyis brgyud 'dzin pas/ las skal ldan pa rnams kyi bon skal yin/ bstan dgra ru tra'i lag tu ma shor cig/
